defects.what: the island is buried under a flat, opaque white cloud sheet that covers most of the ground; it reads like snow fields or a mask, not low cloud. Low cloud should be thin and broken enough that the coast, sea and slopes show through, with soft translucent edges and its tops lit and shaded by the sun

defects.where: upper middle band, along the far cloud field and toward the horizon
defects.what: bright white flecks, streaks and stair-stepped, comb-like edges along the cloud tops (e.g. around x 100-200, 620-700, 890-960 at y 160-220); the cloud boundary should be a soft, clean fade, not sparkling aliased fragments
no sea or land is visible at the horizon; the cloud layer meets a blank cream sky in a hard ragged line. There should be grey-green sea or distant islands and a hazy, gradual horizon

a flat, uniformly bright cream stripe sits between the cloud deck and the sea, with a hard straight top edge at y ~272 and small white specks along it; the sea's far edge ends in a sharp line at y ~345. The sky should brighten gradually toward the horizon and the sea should fade into it through haze, without a pasted band

clouds look like smeared, stretched paint: horizontal streaks, a blotchy dithered patch around x 470-620, y 150-220, and flat grey undersides with no volume. They should have soft but defined forms with lit tops and darker bases under one light

faint thin straight bright lines run diagonally across the clouds (from about x 530,y 300 up to x 880,y 170, and others near the right), like seams or stray line primitives. The sky should have no straight artifact lines
a dotted straight diagonal line of white specks crosses the cloud, plus scattered single white pixels in the sky; same artifact as in lagoon. Clouds should be clean

close-up grass is a uniform repeating blotch pattern of olive and dark patches at one scale, like a bumpy carpet or camouflage print, with no stones, tussocks, wet patches or colour variation; it looks plastic. It should show mixed grass tones, scale variation and occasional rock

defects.where: foreground right slope and left valley
defects.what: the ground colour is a saturated mustard/olive-brown across the whole island; Faroese summer slopes are a cooler, fresher green with darker basalt bands. Ground and the cool grey sky don't look lit by the same light
hills are smooth rounded mounds with no basalt terraces, scree or rock outcrops; they read as soft clay. Faroese valleys should show stepped dark rock layers and cliff bands along the upper slopes

the stream is a uniform light grey ribbon of constant width draped over the slope like a road; near the valley floor it breaks into disconnected white fragments (x 480-570, y 420-470). Streams should narrow and widen, sit in the terrain, catch sky reflections and stay continuous
a small isolated bright white blob floats on the hillside with no context; it should either be a recognisable object or not be there

the sea is a flat dark slate with evenly spaced parallel ripple bands near the beach; the surf line is a thin uniform white outline. Water should show sky reflection, varying wave pattern and foam that breaks unevenly

defects.where: lake in the far valley, x ~700-750, y ~375
defects.what: the lake is a flat pale grey patch with a hard edge; it should reflect the surrounding hills and sky
dark smudgy blotches on the slope look like low-res shadow or texture smears rather than terrain features

overall: Valley and lagoon views have a believable soft northern light and pleasing composition, but the set is held back by a broken overview (opaque white cloud sheet with aliased sparkle hiding the island), artifact lines and a pasted horizon band in the sky, and plastic, overly mustard ground with no basalt structure.
